pr_body:
This lets users customize the metrics data stream mappings, without having to override a managed component template that may get overridden.

Fixes #109475
pr_title: Add metrics@custom component template to metrics-*-* index template
pr_comment: Hi @felixbarny, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

> I also added the test-update-serverless label, so if you merge main into this or update it, it'll make sure nothing will break there (please do that before merging just to make sure).

Good call. I was under the assumption that we're executing the serverless tests on all PRs now.
